key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Lower leaves opposite, upper alternate; blades triangular to ovate, coarsely toothed to lobed, often gray-green and somewhat hairy.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Showy yellow rays with yellow disks.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: bright yellow heads; gray-green hairy foliage; opposite lower leaves; annual habit
